connector.name: Final POS
connector.registryDescription: Build custom POS, kiosk, self-checkout & in-person payment apps with AI agents on Final POS.
connector.summary: Hosted at build.finalpos.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.finalpos.build. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <sk_... organization API key>. Optional if your client supports OAuth 2.1 — mint a key at build.finalpos.com (open a flow, chat rail, cable icon, "Connect your AI tool").
